title: Addon Runtime And Distribution
problem: Addon sidecars and Admin operations exist, but Taru needs a safe package/install/runtime readiness and routing boundary before broader Addon distribution or manager behavior can ship without weakening extension trust boundaries.
gates: npm run check from apps/admin-web after Admin contract/client changes

continue_policy.notes: ARD-050 completed Addon Token handoff routes for Generated Artifacts and acquisition candidates. Generated Artifacts now enter existing AILO proposal semantics through Addon-backed Automation Providers and Addon Task jobs with idempotency replay/conflict checks, stale target rejection, provider capability preservation, redaction, and no Canonical Metadata/NFO/library-file mutation. Acquisition candidates now enter DWI AddonProposed intake records with redacted diagnostics and no Media Source, Managed Import, promotion, or library-file authority. Focused ARD-050 gates passed; the broader taru-server addons gate was attempted but blocked by Windows socket error 10055 and must be retried in a fresh environment before final closeout if required. Continue with ARD-060 closeout/follow-on split. Keep Addon Manager discovery/install/update, marketplace hosting, package signing trust root, process/container supervision, Native Plugin ABI, Jellyfin Plugin Compatibility, direct library writes, downloader protocol adapters, local AI runtime, Public Client API changes, hidden schedulers, and taru-client-protocol changes out of scope unless split into a dedicated lane.
